title: Dario Amodei proposes pacing frontier AI development
friendlyTitle: Anthropic’s CEO wants the fastest AI work to slow down
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei argues that frontier labs should slow capability gains enough for safeguards to catch up. His three-step proposal starts with embedded third-party evaluators, then calls for coordination among companies and governments.
friendlySummary: Dario Amodei says leading AI companies should move more carefully and let independent experts check their safety work. He also wants companies and governments to agree on shared rules.
whyItMatters: This is a concrete governance proposal from inside a leading AI lab, not a general appeal to stop development. If adopted, independent access and shared safety thresholds could affect model release schedules, procurement decisions, and the evidence customers receive about high-capability systems.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could change when powerful models are released and what proof businesses get that those models are safe enough to use.
